hypothesis: Leaning money toward the strategy families that suit the market's mood beats spreading it equally (fund b beats fund a after costs).

regime_measurements.breadth: share of S&P 500 members (same list as the stock shadows) whose close is above their own 200-session average
regime_measurements.roughness: SPY annualised 20-session volatility vs the median of the same measure over the past 252 sessions

labels: direction 'up' when at least 2 of: trend above; breadth >= 50%; IEF 60-session return >= 0. 'rough' when 20-session volatility is above its 252-session median, else 'calm'. Labels: calm up, rough up, calm down, rough down. Written once per US session, the night of that session, to the append-only allocator_labels table.
lines: the league's rules lines (not yardsticks, not FX-COUNCIL): a family's share split equally between its lines with a value that day; a family with none today waits in cash (Y-CASH).

funds.a (ALLOC-EQUAL): every rules line the same share, rebalanced at the first session of each month
funds.b (ALLOC-RULES): the table, rebalanced when the label changes and at the first session of each month
funds.c: NOT BUILT (AI reduce-or-skip; needs Markus's yes on cost)

limits: both funds: no line above 40% (excess to cash); total exposure at most 1.5x (2x funds count double, BIL counts nothing, forex counts its gross), scaled down into cash; a 15% fall from the fund's high moves it to cash for good and raises one alarm, until Markus resets it.
costs: each line's own costs are inside its value; moving money between lines costs 5 bps of the amount moved (the league's per-trade cost).
timing: decided at a session's close from that session's label; earns from the next session.
pass_bar: Roadmap Phase 4: the Allocator passes only if fund (b) beat fund (a) after costs (January 2028). The size of 'beat' is UNKNOWN until Markus sets it.
